text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Paka Petit really is great after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It's adorable... and above all,
it brings back the drama of those days, stirring my heart."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If I can build up a great record and leave my name in history...
my Paka Petit might become something like that too, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If that's the case, I'd love to display it
in my room along with my historical records.
